title: Pale sandy cobbles for the city streets
chosen_from: material_variants.py round mat2, variant v2_pale_cobble, judged on South_StreetHero34, SW_NarrowStreet43 and East_QuarterStreet58 on 2026-09-13
why: The southern and western streets read grey and gritty: the cobble tint (linear 0.41/0.39/0.39) over a dark cobble texture made the streets look like asphalt. The reference's ground is pale and sandy.
